spine: 1. ClickHouse Cloud 的查詢尾延遲不再是『一個 thread 算了很多東西』，而是『一萬個小操作以某種順序完成、最慢的那個塑造了 tail』——這把瓶頸從 CPU 算力轉移到 I/O 與調度。
2. OS thread 作為併發單位太貴：每次 context switch 幾微秒、每條 stack 數 KB、數量有限到 kernel 自己會被 context switch 拖死；高併發 I/O 工作負載需要更便宜的併發單位。
3. Silk 是一個 C++ 的 cooperative fiber scheduler，把多到上千的 fiber 對映到固定數量（每 CPU 一條、pin 住）的 OS thread——這就是 M:N，N 是 CPU 數而非 fiber 數。
4. scheduler 的核心是 per-CPU 的 ProcessorState：bounded ready queue（Vyukov MPMC）、io_uring ring、按 deadline 排序的 sleep tree、一個兼當 wakeup doorbell 的 eventfd；local queue 乾了就按 topology 成本去偷工作。
5. stack 與同步原語的記憶體策略是『init 後 hot path 零配置』：fiber stack 從 mmap pool 取、兩側有 guard page、永不釋放；queue node、waiter hook 都是 Fiber 物件內的 intrusive 欄位。
6. 取捨是真實的：cooperative 表示 fiber 必須主動 yield，沒有 preemption；Linux-only、依賴 io_uring/rseq；scheduler 是 process-wide singleton；profiler 還不認得 fiber identity；entry-point 參數限 64 bytes。
7. 對台灣工程師的判斷：建高併發、I/O-bound、tail-latency 敏感的 Linux C++ 服務時值得考慮 fiber runtime；CPU-bound、需要跨平台、或團隊吃不下『無 preemption + 除錯工具不成熟』的，不該上。

perspective.mechanism: M:N fiber runtime 如何運作：per-CPU pinned scheduler thread 各擁一個 ProcessorState（ready queue + io_uring ring + sleep tree + eventfd），cooperative 地把上千 fiber 多工到固定 OS thread 上，local queue 乾了就 topology-aware work-steal；stack 與同步結構走 init 後零配置的 intrusive/mmap-pool 策略。
perspective.tradeoff: 用 cooperative（無 preemption、fiber 須主動 yield）換低 context-switch 成本；綁死 Linux 與 io_uring/rseq；process-wide singleton；profiler 尚未 fiber-aware；參數限 64 bytes。換來的是固定 OS thread 預算下更高的查詢併發與更可控的 tail latency。
perspective.reader_use: 判斷自家高併發 C++ 服務該不該引入 fiber runtime：I/O-bound + tail-latency 敏感 + Linux server-class 就值得評估；CPU-bound、跨平台、或承受不起無 preemption 與不成熟除錯工具的場景則不該上。

notes.quote: ten thousand tiny operations completed in a particular order, and the slowest of them shaped the tail.
notes.interpretation: ClickHouse Cloud 的查詢尾延遲已從 compute-bound 轉成 coordination/I-O-bound，瓶頸是調度而非算力。

notes.quote: A few microseconds per context switch, kilobytes of stack, and a finite number of them before the kernel starts context-switching itself to death.
notes.interpretation: OS thread 作為主要併發單位的三個成本：context switch 時間、stack 記憶體、thread 數量上限。

notes.quote: Silk is a C++ library that gives you a cooperative fiber scheduler, backed by a per-CPU scheduler that uses io_uring for asynchronous I/O and steals work between cores when local queues run dry.
notes.interpretation: Silk 的一句話定義：cooperative fiber scheduler + per-CPU scheduler + io_uring async I/O + work stealing。

notes.quote: The scheduler runs one OS thread per CPU, pinned. Each scheduler thread owns a per-CPU ProcessorState containing a bounded ready queue (a Vyukov MPMC queue with cache-line-aligned producer/consumer slots), an io_uring ring for asynchronous I/O and timer expiry, a sleep tree ordered by deadline, and an eventfd that doubles as a wakeup doorbell.
notes.interpretation: scheduler 拓樸：每 CPU 一條 pin 住的 OS thread，各擁一個 ProcessorState；ProcessorState 的四個組件清單。

notes.quote: Work stealing is topology-aware...sorted by estimated cost: hyperthread siblings first (about a microsecond), same-socket cores next (about fifty microseconds), and cross-socket cores last (about five hundred microseconds).
notes.interpretation: work stealing 按 CPU 拓樸成本排序偷工作：HT sibling ~1µs、同 socket ~50µs、跨 socket ~500µs。

notes.quote: Each fiber's stack is mmap'd from a per-fiber pool with guard pages on either side.
notes.interpretation: fiber stack 來自 mmap 的 per-fiber pool，兩側有 guard page 偵測 overflow/underflow。

notes.quote: After init, the hot path does no allocation at all. Not less than other libraries, zero.
notes.interpretation: init 之後 hot path 完全不做 heap 配置——強調是『零』而非『比別人少』。

notes.quote: Every container is intrusive: the queue node, suspended-list entry, lock-free-stack hook, and waiter-table hook are _fields inside the Fiber object itself_, not separate allocations.
notes.interpretation: 同步/調度用的資料結構都是 Fiber 物件內的 intrusive 欄位，不是分開配置——這是 hot path 零配置的實作手段。

notes.quote: io_uring as the I/O ground truth rather than as a backend bolted onto an older reactor design.
notes.interpretation: io_uring 是設計的 I/O 基底，不是事後接在舊 reactor 上的後端。

notes.quote: fibers participate in cooperative multitasking instead of the preemptive multitasking that threads use; allowing fibers to yield their work instead of block on it.
notes.interpretation: fiber 走 cooperative multitasking、不是 thread 的 preemptive——fiber 主動 yield 而不是 block。

notes.quote: Silk is Linux-only. It depends on io_uring, eventfd, mmap with guard pages, rseq, and the modern Linux capability model.
notes.interpretation: Silk 只跑 Linux，依賴 io_uring、eventfd、帶 guard page 的 mmap、rseq、現代 Linux capability model。

notes.quote: the scheduler is a process-wide singleton, accessed via static methods on FiberScheduler. There is no way to instantiate two isolated schedulers in the same process.
notes.interpretation: scheduler 是 process 範圍的 singleton，同一 process 內無法開兩個隔離的 scheduler。

notes.quote: the fiber API requires entry-point parameters to fit in 64 bytes (FIBER_PARAMETERS_SIZE).
notes.interpretation: fiber entry-point 參數必須塞進 64 bytes（FIBER_PARAMETERS_SIZE），更大要 heap 配置後傳指標。

notes.quote: the profiler shipping with the library is, in its current form, a generic on-CPU and off-CPU sampling profiler...not yet aware of fiber identity...A working GDB extension that handles both x86_64 and aarch64.
notes.interpretation: 隨附 profiler 目前還不認得 fiber identity；有一個支援 x86_64 與 aarch64 的 GDB extension。

notes.quote: silk is in a state where it would value being kicked at...the first probable target is our distributed cache.
notes.interpretation: Silk 現階段歡迎被人來踩、來測；ClickHouse 內部第一個可能的整合目標是 distributed cache。

notes.quote: If you trace a query through ClickHouse Cloud, increasingly the long pole is not 'a thread did a lot of computation,' it is 'ten thousand tiny operations completed in a particular order, and the slowest of them shaped the tail.'
notes.interpretation: 追一條 ClickHouse Cloud 查詢，長 pole 越來越不是 compute，而是大量小操作的協調與其中最慢者塑造 tail。
